title: Zesty Charred Japanese Chinese Cabbage Kushikatsu
description: A weeknight Japanese dish featuring charred and tender Chinese cabbage, served in a crispy kushikatsu form, perfect for ovo-vegetarian diets
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, mix together the flour, panko breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs and set aside
Dip each piece of Chinese cabbage into the flour mixture, then the eggs, and finally the flour mixture again
Carefully place the coated cabbage pieces into the hot oil and fry until golden brown
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fried cabbage from the oil and place on a paper towel lined plate to drain excess oil
In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil, and bring to a boil over medium heat
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the sauce for 5 minutes
To serve, place the fried cabbage pieces on a plate and brush with the zesty sauce
